definition: The Access Node Control Protocol (ANCP) carries Quality of Service, service-related and subscriber-related configuration and operations between a Network Access Server and an Access Node such as a DSLAM. The NAS sends requests to the Access Node, which authorises the actions and replies, and the Access Node in turn provides status reports.
plainLanguage: The protocol a provider uses to tell the cabinet at the end of the street what quality of service to give each line.
